name: 状態の解除候補と指定日時
prompt:
Recreate a faithful static Japanese Slack “Clear after…” screen component. Use the exact original source crop for the seven-row layout, radio controls, dimming, floating time-picker geometry and color relationships; use the Japanese native preview for exact localized wording and the final 390×382 canvas.

The assigned source crop begins below the original English header, so do not add a header or title. Include only the seven left-aligned options, right-aligned radio circles, the floating time-wheel card over the right half, and the two date/time pills at the bottom:
「解除しない」
「30分後」
「1時間後」
「4時間後」
「今日」
「今週」
「日時を指定」

The selected option is 「日時を指定」, indicated by a blue outlined radio at the far right. The background list is lightly dimmed behind a translucent white picker card with large rounded corners, located over the middle-right of the option list. Show three vertical picker columns. The selected center row is 「12」 | 「00」 | 「午後」 on a wide, rounded neutral-gray band. Nearby rows fade softly: above are 「10」 | 「00」 | 「午前」 and 「11」 | 「30」 | 「午前」; below are 「1」 | 「30」 | 「午後」 and 「2」 | 「00」 | 「午後」. Match the source's picker card around x=138,y=93,width=230,height=203 on a 390×382 canvas, with the selection band centered near y=194.

At the bottom, show two rounded date/time pills around y=330: 「6月4日」 in dark text and 「12:00」 in blue text. Keep the time value blue as requested because it is presented as a hyperlink-like selectable value. Blue belongs only on the selected custom radio and the time value; keep every option label and date label dark. Use restrained light gray surfaces and the source's compact spacing.

The source crop is 390×341 while the native preview target is 390×382. Follow the preview canvas height, preserve the source's picker geometry, and leave the expanded lower spacing for the date/time pills visible in the preview.

No extra phone chrome, footer, branding, app header, buttons, or unrelated text. Static image only; do not imply an interactive wheel.
reviewNotes: Exact Japanese options/date and blue 12:00 text are preserved; selected custom radio is blue. Picker card is narrower than source and lower option rows drift. Mark needs-correction.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
